headline: South Africa Economic Gauge Rises 1.1% as Reserve Bank Holds Rate at 7.25%
summary: South Africa's leading economic indicator increased 1.1% in August while the South African Reserve Bank maintained its main repo rate at 7.25% in a 4-3 decision.
why: The South African Reserve Bank targets inflation between 3% and 6% using its key policy repo rate.

impacts.name: South African Repo Rate
impacts.why: The South African Reserve Bank voted 4-3 to keep its benchmark interest rate unchanged at 7.25%.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
